reason: I buy to resell, so every dinar on the landed cost comes out of my margin. 13,000 a kilo by air plus 8% on top, with no price for bulk, means I can't beat what the Shorja wholesalers already sell me off the shelf, and I'd wait 2 to 3 weeks for it.
objection: There's no rate for quantity. If I bring in 50 chargers or a box of car parts, I don't know what it costs per piece. And if half the batch is fake or doesn't work, 'damaged or not as ordered' doesn't tell me who decides that or how fast I get my money back.
would_change_my_mind: A wholesale rate for bulk orders, like cheaper per-kilo shipping or sea cargo for big boxes and a lower buying fee above a certain amount, plus a promise that they test the electronics in the warehouse photos before shipping.
